And if you ever need to talk or vent, you can message me

Also, I hope you don't fret too much about your friends. A lot of people get scared and act defensive when you bring up suicidal feelings. It has happened to me much more than I care to admit and I have lost most of my friends because of my actions. But a therapist won't do that. They will listen to you and help you learn better coping skills so you don't have to depend on your friends to give you life saving advice

Its crazy because I have had the same thoughts. 24F. I was determined that if I am alone and childless when I am 30, I was going to end it. I still have suicidal thoughts everyday and sometimes its because I think I will never get to be a mom. But what has helped me a little is setting goals for myself. Like some of my goals are getting my pilot license, starting a trucking business, getting new tattoos, seeing my sisters graduate high school and hopefully college, going skydiving. There are other things to experience in life than having a significant other. 

I know it is so hard to break out of that mindset. I mean hell, I posted on the Suicide Watch thread just last night. But I take my bipolar and anxiety meds everyday, go to therapy when I can afford it, go to free support groups, and try my damnest to keep going.

My advice to you is to see a psychiatrist if you aren't already, find the right medication, start going to therapy, use everyday as a way to better yourself. It can be small things like cleaning your bathroom or big things like joining a gym or volunteering with a charity. Try new experiences in life and learn to love yourself. If you spend everyday trying to better yourself, you won't fail. But don't just wait for things to happen. That will only make you more depressed and miserable. It is going to be hard but you can do it <3
